args.note: I've written the cold read for all three issues to cold-read.md. Issue 01 has the best hook: the birthday debt on page 2, B11, and the 18% vs 62% water numbers. I nearly quit at page 5 but would read on (next issue: yes). In Issue 02 I'd put it down at page 24 (next issue: no). In Issue 03 I'd put it down at page 42 (next book: no). Main problems: - Alpha, the Water Wars, the Covenant bands, Ada's relationship to Alex, and why Alex wants to go to Halyard are never explained, or explained too late. - The Tomas cliffhanger is dropped and answered off-page. - Mara and Mera are easy to mix up, and I couldn't tell the four collaborators apart. - Every character talks in the same clipped, balanced lines, which a class already suspicious of AI will notice. - Page 51 seems to contradict page 16: the public board says 62% again after Alex published the true numbers. Best moments: page 2, page 28, Ada and Leona on pages 39–40, page 43, and "Pipe says eighteen" on page 51. The page most likely to lose a class is 42, with page 20 as the early leak.
